The attached B1 room and original hooded archer are the strongest surface-simplicity authorities. Do not interpret the Darkest Dungeon reference as a request for texture. Keep exactly this fallen Dead pose: body lies on its side, head lowered toward right, eyes fully shut, spear lying diagonally along foreground to left. Same hands gripping/free as image 1; keep every silhouette extremum and physical contact. Not a cute sleeping goblin; a limp spent dungeon hunter, with eyes swallowed by the deep hood. No blood additions, no new objects.
